description: RegEvidenceHub CQC helps users navigate England CQC provider-registration, provider-change, application-readiness, and statutory-notification workflows. It identifies the relevant workflow, reports bounded official-source status, and lists the facts to prepare before a regulatory preflight. It uses only user-supplied facts, does not request patient records, does not submit anything to CQC, and does not provide CQC approval or legal advice.

defaultPrompt: Which CQC workflow should I use if I am opening a new home-care service in England?
We are already CQC registered and want to add a regulated activity. Which workflow applies?
What facts should I prepare before checking whether an incident needs a CQC statutory notification?
